name: 6layer-impedance
description: Rigid FR4, six copper layers with controlled impedance and length matching. Same gates as 4-layer with a deeper stackup and stricter review.
notes: Use at least one continuous reference plane per high-speed signal layer.
The stackup must be confirmed by the fabricator; generic FR4 numbers are not a professional sign-off.
Confirm layer transitions, return vias and plane splits before release.
